title: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to enforce the channel Access…
description: Mattermost versions 11.11.0 and earlier in the 11.11.x series, 11.7.11 and earlier in the 11.7.x series, and 11.10.2 and earlier in the 11.10.x series do not properly enforce the channel Access Control Policy's file download permission check when serving file metadata and thumbnails via drafts, scheduled posts, and post edit history endpoints. This allows authenticated users who no longer have permission under the policy to view metadata and thumbnails of file attachments, although direct file access remains correctly denied.
